get.description:
Returns the kernel module metadata for the given kernel module metadata request input.

If the module name is not found in the metadata, returns a 404 (Not Found).
If we can't conclusively determine which metadata to return, returns a 409 (Conflict).

The returned response will be the metadata that best matches the given information.

post.summary: Bulk retrieval of kernel module metadata
post.description:
Bulk retrieval of kernel module metadata.

Returns a list of kernel module metadata responses for the given list of kernel module metadata request inputs.
If a module name is either not found in the metadata or we can't conclusively determine which metadata to return,
the corresponding response will be None.

The returned list will have the same length as the input list, and the order of the responses will match the order
of the input list.

schema.title: Response Get Kernel Module Metadata Bulk Kernel Module Metadata Post

post.summary: Get packages that contain feature values
post.description:
Given a feature type and a list or set of feature values, return results containing
the packages that apply to each feature value. If max_cardinality is not None, then
only return the set of packages for feature values that have a cardinality less than
or equal to max_cardinality.

parameters.name: feature_type

schema.description: The feature type to get packages for

parameters.description: The feature type to get packages for

parameters.name: max_cardinality

schema.description: The maximum number of packages that a feature value can belong to (inclusive). Any feature belonging to more packages than this will be returned in the 'max_cardinality_exceeded' list. If not specified, no cardinality limit will be imposed.
schema.title: Max Cardinality

parameters.description: The maximum number of packages that a feature value can belong to (inclusive). Any feature belonging to more packages than this will be returned in the 'max_cardinality_exceeded' list. If not specified, no cardinality limit will be imposed.

schema.description: The feature values to get packages for. Every value is guaranteed to be in the returned result, either with a list of packages containing the feature value, an empty list if the feature value does not exist, or in the 'max_cardinality_limit_exceeded list if the feature value exists but has more packages than the max_cardinality parameter allows for.

post.summary: Get component metadata for a list of component ids
post.description:
Given a list of component ids, returns a dictionary of component id to component metadata.
If a component id does not exist, then it's value in the returned dictionary will be null.

post.summary: Get 'evidence info' for a list of package hashes
post.description:
Given a list of package hashes, return the 'evidence info' dictionary for each.
This is a dictionary of information about the features of a package, including
the count of unique feature values for each feature type and the total inverse
document frequency score of each type's features. If a package hash does not exist
in the ground-truth collection, then its value in the returned dictionary will be null.

schema.title: Package Hashes
schema.description: The list of package hashes to retrieve evidence info for. This can only be up to 10000 values in a single request.

schema.title: Response Evidence Info Bulk Sca Pkg Evidence Info Post

post.summary: Fuzzy matches a given set of binary terms to terms extracted from files in the ground-truth collection.
post.description:
Given a set of binary terms and a term type, fuzzy matches the terms against
terms extracted from files in the ground-truth collection. Only matches with the
highest match score are returned.

get.description:
Forcefully reloads all common binary terms and caches them globally.
This endpoint can be used to trigger a re-load of common binary terms
whenever desired without having to restart the server. Since the terms
are cached globally, all requests to the server that use the common terms
will run much faster if they are preloaded. Note that by default, the
common terms are loaded on server startup so calling this endpoint is
not essential in production.

schema.title: Response Load Common Binary Terms Sca Load Common Binary Terms Get

post.summary: Match subcomponent ground-truth term sets for a given set of input terms
post.description:
Matches subcomponent ground-truth term sets for a given set of input terms.
Returns the information regarding each matched ground-truth subcomponent, including
name, version, score, and details on a per-term-type basis.

get.description:
Retrieves all ground-truth term sets for a given subcomponent _key.
Terms are returned in dictionary where the keys are the term types
and the values are lists of terms.

Subcomponent IDs can be found in the `subcomponent_id` field of the
matches returned by the `/fuzzy_match_subcomponent_terms` endpoint.

If the subcomponent key is not known, a 404 error is returned.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: The subcomponent key to get terms for
schema.title: Id

get.summary: Generate software identifiers for the given set of component metadata.
get.description:
Returns a list of software identifiers (CPEs, PURLs, etc.) for the given component metadata.
Returned identifiers are sorted by confidence (descending) and then by type and value (ascending).

schema.title: Response Get Software Ids Software Ids Get

post.summary: Generate software identifiers for multiple sets of component metadata.
post.description:
Returns a list of software identifiers (CPEs, PURLs, etc.) for the given list of component information.
Returned identifiers are contained in lists (one per input), guaranteed to be in the same order
as the inputs. Within the individual lists of identifiers, they are sorted by confidence (descending)
and then by type and value (ascending).

parameters.name: generate_purl_only

schema.description: Boolean indicating whether to only generate purl only for ALL components in the input list. This will override the setting on component list input.
schema.title: Generate Purl Only

parameters.description: Boolean indicating whether to only generate purl only for ALL components in the input list. This will override the setting on component list input.

post.summary: Match vulnerabilities to the given set of software IDs
post.description:
Matches vulnerabilities for all given software identifiers. Matched CVEs are returned in order of confidence,
with the most confident matches listed first. Each returned CVE contains a list of the software IDs
affected by the vulnerability.

:param request: The incoming request
:param use_cache: Whether to use the cache when matching vulnerabilities. Defaults to true.
:param sw_ids: List of software identifiers to match
:return: List of matched vulnerabilities

post.summary: Retrieve package metadata for the given PURL.
post.description:
Retrieve package metadata for a list of pURLs

By default, fuzzy matching is disabled. If you want to enable it, set the `enable_fuzzy_matching` flag to True.
This will increase response times, sometimes dramatically, depending on how many of the given PURLs have exact
matches in the database. Use with caution!

:param body: POST body should contain BulkPackageMetadataRequest

post.summary: Retrieve package metadata for the given PURL.

:param timestamp: limits the results to only metadata updated after the timestamp value
:param enable_fuzzy_matching: whether to enable fuzzy matching (default: True)
